tools.name: search_playlist
tools.description: Search four starter tracks by song, artist or mood. This is a dated starter selection, not a live or complete Spotify catalogue. Returns metadata and listening links only.

tools.name: get_creation_template
tools.description: Return one of two original adult-character scene prompts for a PS2-inspired concept. This prepares text only and never submits or charges an AI generation request.

tools.name: prepare_video_project
tools.description: Prepare a free local-workspace JSON draft from 1–12 song/artist title cards and three original captions. Save the project field as JSON, then import it on the linked workspace. It does not render a video, fetch audio or provide song lyrics.
